release_notes: Safer duplicate finder: system, app, cloud-synced and backup files are now left out of scans, and you're warned before any deletion that can't go to the Recycle Bin (oversized files, removable drives, or when the bin is turned off). Automatic macros are now verified before they run - existing scheduled or triggered macros need to be opened and saved once to keep firing. Display fixes for high-DPI and scaled screens: the window fits properly, results windows are readable, and scrolling is faster. Health alerts no longer repeat when CPU and memory are both busy. Licence checks are more tolerant of hardware changes. Includes all v1.0.4 fixes.
